correctness.rationale: The hypotheses and conclusion were reconstructed from the published definitions. For independent Exp(log 2) components, the CDNCEx component reduces to an explicit integral J. Its derivative is strictly positive. Under Y_i=2X_i, exact scaling gives CJ_i^Y(2,2)=2J(1), whereas CJ_i^X(2,2)=J(2), and the exact difference is (57-80 log 2)/(36 log 2)>0. The strict sign is proved analytically from exp(7/10)>2.
